name: Bitwarden
description: Bitwarden is an open-source, end-to-end encrypted password manager described by the vendor as "the most trusted password manager," securing passwords, passkeys, and secrets for people, AI agents, and machines.
best_for: The vendor states millions of users choose it to protect themselves and their families, alongside businesses and development/DevOps teams needing secrets management.
features: Secure Send for sharing sensitive info

alternatives.name: 1Password
alternatives.description: Password manager with Watchtower vulnerability alerts and Travel Mode.
alternatives.best_for: Teams and families wanting polished native apps and secret key security

alternatives.name: Keeper
alternatives.description: Cybersecurity password vault with role-based policies and SCIM provisioning.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations needing strict compliance and automated user provisioning

alternatives.name: Dashlane
alternatives.description: Secure password vault with built-in VPN and dark web monitoring.
alternatives.best_for: Users seeking bundled VPN and password security

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Basic personal password management is always free.

tiers.name: Teams
tiers.notes: $4/user/month billed annually; centralized sharing, event logs, directory sync, and SCIM.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: $6/user/month billed annually; adds granular controls, passwordless SSO integration, account recovery, self-hosting, and a free Families plan for users.
